verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS project-management product and its MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The cited material covers the API, MCP setup, pricing features and integrations only.
